Description: Knowledge and insights developed over the course of developing the national eHealth vision.
Examples:
Opportunities to re-use or share existing components
Gaps that need to be filled
Risks and barriers associated with opportunities and gaps
Dependencies on the establishment of other components
High-level estimates of the magnitude of funding and duration to establish the required components

Description: Guidance and direction provided by political and health sector decision makers and stakeholders.
Examples:
Desire for a national eHealth vision and how it should balance:
– short-term eHealth outcomes (1–3 years)
– long-term eHealth outcomes (5– 10 years).
Opinions on what is likely to be achievable within the timeframe given the political and health sector landscape
Likely available resources and funding that the country has (or will have) to direct towards implementing the vision
